subtopic: Financial Professional Compensation and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: Your financial professional could receive more or less compensation depending on the share class you purchase.
answer: Mutual fund share classes can differ in sales loads, 12b-1 fees, and other charges, and some of these fees may compensate the professional who helps you buy or sell shares. Because compensation can vary by share class, a professional may have a potential conflict of interest when recommending one class over another. Compare the available classes and ask why a particular class was recommended, including how its fees and expenses affect your total cost.
